purpose: Separate production-shaped batched-cell plugin: scalar comparison inside real REAPER, no installation

reaper.license: Official fully functional evaluation; no copied license or license bypass

arms.name: scalar
arms.plugin: VST3: M3 Polyphonic Audio to MIDI

protocol.host: REAPER 7.86, isolated profiles, JACK dummy 96000/512, scalar then batch, one recording each
protocol.configuration: Production defaults, factory calibration, Single routing channel 1. No offline diagnostic policy macros.
protocol.identity: Compare ordered phase-1 MIDI rows at 0 <= sample < 10689600 including block offset, status, note and velocity, with no time shift or tolerance. Full source consumed continuously. Tail/Panic are separate controls, not clock-aligned by wall time.
protocol.state: Save Input trim +6 dB, mutate to -12 dB, restore +6 dB, restore all frozen production defaults before playback.
protocol.panic: Silence input upstream while notes are held, invoke Panic, require releases, no new notes, zero final owners and host parameter Ready within 3 seconds.
protocol.native_tests: Both production-shaped realtime suites, including existing allocation/deadline assertions; batch detector configure/reset under production macros. Existing diagnostic core tests retained.
protocol.pairing: Report raw pairing for each arm; preserved scalar pairing defects are not repaired or reclassified by this optimization.
protocol.limits: Host delivery on dummy audio only; no device, live guitar, musical improvement, acoustic re-pluck or installed acceptance.
protocol.failure: Fail closed, retain logs; no automatic retry or second dispatch.
protocol.artifacts: Small report/logs collected once; bundles and host events remain remote.
